title: K2 Space line reveal
description: A heading or statement whose lines fade in and rise as they scroll up the window, scrubbed with the scroll, one line after another. Every word carries its own view timeline, so words on the same line share a position and reveal together without measuring lines.
notes: a "\n" in the text is a line break; with desktopBreaksOnly the breaks apply from 1024px only
CSS only: without scroll-timeline support or under reduced motion the text simply shows
rise sets the distance: sm 17px (phones' 34px type), md 24px, lg 36px (72px display type)
